contract.structural_score_basis: The fresh security_analyst walk resolves DSPauseProxy as the only full-reach upgrade and ward-administration path. DSPause currently provides 48 hours of notice, but the delay has no demonstrated hard floor and proposal and cancellation share DSChief authority. UsdsJoin is a second ward with an immediate but fixed DAI-to-USDS conversion surface; it has no arbitrary-call, rely, deny or upgrade route. Narrowing that path does not remove the full governance route, so Contract and Admin remains 7.0.
code_facts: USDS uses a MakerDAO-derived codebase with a long operating history.
USDS is upgradeable, and governance can add or change transfer restrictions.
UsdsJoin mint and burn authority is bounded by fixed conversion accounting rather than general administration.
